recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-48690 unless a future work-group decision revises the DeviceAssociation Boundaries and Relationships wording.
issue_request: FHIR-48690 was Applied/Not Persuasive with Modification for R6. It asked that the Device entry in DeviceAssociation Boundaries and Relationships be removed or made clearer because the old text focused on association history/PHI and misspelled "including"; the approved motion replaced it with: "Device - The device that is, e.g., used, placed in or on, or owned by the subject referenced in the DeviceAssociation."
initial_application: The issue was first applied in f2c0525483, which replaced the stale Device boundary text in source/deviceassociation/deviceassociation-introduction.xml. Jira then records that the change had been overwritten by a merge conflict and was re-applied in b6decac141 via PR #3600/#3606.
additional_context: DeviceAssociation is active current-build scope in source/fhir.ini. Later DeviceAssociation introduction work, especially FHIR-47931/FHIR-47604 in 8e08ddcec8, replaced the broader Boundaries and Relationships section while preserving the FHIR-48690 Device wording exactly. FHIR-51524 touched the same introduction page but only removed an unrelated Scope and Usage parenthetical. OO/HCP Confluence minutes are consistent with the Jira vote, and Zulip search found no conflicting rationale.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The combined branch already has the approved Device text in source/deviceassociation/deviceassociation-introduction.xml, and searches of current DeviceAssociation/Device source found no stale history/PHI wording or "incluuding" misspelling.
